verdict.rationale: Blink's docs explicitly claim Mosh-based session persistence across network changes ('jump from home, to the train, and then to the office... rock-solid connected') and device sleep ('put your device to sleep, when you wake it up later, your connections will be intact'), directly matching the story. Community feedback corroborates solid connectivity ('solid connectivity', 'refresh seems faster than Prompt'). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically testing sleep/network-switch persistence and no discussion of edge-case failures.
